summary: Perfect Moment Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of warrants and shares under previously disclosed loan and securities purchase agreements. The company issued to X3 Higher Moment Fund LLC warrants for 1,864,753 shares at $0.46822 per share, and to Krane Capital shares and warrants covering up to 8,276,944 shares at $0.40 per share (share price $0.33). The securities were issued under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is described.
